channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as US Dollar rises on safe-haven demand
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground for the second successive day, trading around 0.8100 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar rises on increased safe-haven demand amid heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Flag breakdown supports more downside towards 1.1325
item.description: The Euro (EUR) holds opening losses at around 1.1390 against the US Dollar (USD) during the mid-Asian trading session on Monday. The major currency pair faces selling pressure as the US Dollar starts the week on a strong note due to an increase in the appeal of safe-haven assets.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Edges higher above 184.50, but stays capped by clustered resistance
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 184.65 during the Asian trading hours on Monday. However, the potential upside for the cross might be limited as heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East could boost a safe-haven currency.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Retreats further from multi-week top but holds above 0.6900
item.description: The AUD/USD pair builds on its modest weekly bearish gap opening and retreats further from a two-and-a-half-week top, near the 0.6970 region, touched on Friday. Spot prices drop to the 0.6930-0.6925 area during the Asian session as escalating US-Iran tensions underpin the safe-haven US Dollar (USD).

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds above 101.00 on Middle East tensions
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is remaining stronger for the second successive day, trading around 101.10 during the Asian session on Monday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar edges lower as US launches new wave of strikes against Iran
item.description: The USD/CAD pair gains traction to near 1.4165, snapping the four-day losing streak during the Asian trading hours on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) amid lingering tensions regarding the US-Iran conflict.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $59.00 amid rising US-Iran strikes
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around $59.00 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Japanese Yen weakens vs USD as Iran tensions and rate gap counter intervention risks
item.description: The USD/JPY pair builds on Friday's late rebound from the 161.30-161.25 region and gains strong positive traction at the start of a new week. The momentum lifts spot prices back above the 162.00 round figure during the Asian session and is sponsored by a combination of supporting factors.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
item.description: NZD/USD depreciates after three days of losses, trading around 0.5750 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency pair holds onto its losses as the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) remains subdued, failing to find immediate support despite a positive turnaround in local economic data.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7972 vs. 6.7989 previous
item.description: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7972 compared to Friday's fix of 6.7989 and 6.7850 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Gold falls below $4,100 as fresh US-Iran strikes stoke inflation fears
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) attracts some sellers to near $4,070 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The precious metal extends its decline amid escalating tensions between the US and Iran.

item.title: British Pound remains depressed below 1.3400 as escalating US-Iran tensions underpin USD
item.description: The GBP/USD pair finds some support near 1.3370 after a modest gap-down opening on Monday, though it lacks bullish conviction and remains below 1.3400.

item.title: WTI surges above $74.00 as US-Iran strikes reignite Hormuz risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price rises after two days of losses, trading around $74.20 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Euro weakens to near 1.1400 as US-Iran escalation boosts US Dollar
item.description: The EUR/USD pair edges lower to around 1.1400 during the early Asian session on Monday, pressured by heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: Australian Dollar declines below 0.6950 as US, Iran launch new round of strikes
item.description: The AUD/USD pair loses ground to near 0.6940 during the early Asian session on Monday. Renewed tensions in the Middle East weigh on the riskier assets such as the Australian Dollar (AUD) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: US military says it launched fresh strikes against Iran on Sunday
item.description: The US Central Command (CENTCOM) said that it launched additional strikes against Iran on Sunday aimed at further weakening the Islamic Republic’s ability to strike civilian vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, Bloomberg reported.

item.title: Singapore: Resilient GDP and strong NODX – DBS
item.description: DBS economists Radhika Rao and Mo Ji forecast Singapore’s advance 2Q26 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth at 5.8% year-on-year and 1.5% quarter-on-quarter seasonally adjusted, slightly below 1Q26 but still resilient.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: Lower high structure holds, bear's eye $55.00
item.description: Silver price retreats on Friday during the North American session, edging down by 0.54%, weighed by high US Treasury yields and a sudden shift in market sentiment, after US President Trump revealed that the ceasefire is “over.” At the time of writing, the XAG/USD trades at $59.66.

item.title: Taiwan Dollar: CBC inflation risks support against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s report on Taiwan notes that stronger inflation, with core CPI at 2.5%, is likely to push the CBC towards a more hawkish stance, including a possible 12.5 bp hike in H2.

item.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: US CPI and Warsh testimony to test the Dollar’s recovery
item.description: The upcoming week will bring a major test for the US Dollar (USD), with investors focusing on the United States Consumer Price Index (CPI), Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh’s congressional testimony and a broad set of activity indicators.

item.title: South Korean Won: Rate hike support from exports and inflation – DBS
item.description: DBS economists Radhika Rao and Mo Ji expect the Bank of Korea (BoK) to raise its base rate to 2.75% from 2.50% in July, citing persistent CPI inflation above 3% and resilient growth.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah: Weakness risks persist – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan highlights the Indonesian rupiah’s continued vulnerability as USD/IDR moved back above 18,000 amid renewed Middle East tensions and elevated US yields.

item.title: Gold price slips as Trump says Iran ceasefire is over
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) price retreats on Friday during the North American session, pressured by US President Donald Trump's comments allowing the resumption of US-Iran talks, but reiterating that the ceasefire is “over.” The XAU/USD pair trades at around $4,103, down 0.48%.

item.title: Malaysian Ringgit: Range-bound outlook holds against US Dollar – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) kept the Overnight Policy Rate (OPR) at 2.75% and expects it to stay on hold through 2026, with domestic fundamentals described as broadly supportive.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Reflation gap weighs against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analysts highlight that China’s June Consumer Price Index (CPI) slowed to 1.0% year-on-year while Producer Price Index (PPI) rose 4.1%, widening the PPI-CPI gap and squeezing downstream margins.

item.title: United States Dollar Index steady as traders weigh geopolitics, Fed outlook
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) trades within a volatile range on Friday as a sparse US economic calendar leaves traders watching developments in the Middle East after renewed hostilities between the United States (US) and Iran this week.

item.title: Euro trades flat despite soft European inflation
item.description: EUR/USD trades in a muted fashion near the 1.1430 area on Friday, as a weaker US Dollar (USD) helps the pair hold onto modest Thursday gains. That was true even after inflation data from Germany and France showed limited price pressure.

item.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average treats the ceasefire's second death as a rerun
item.description: The Dow Jones Industrial Average trades at 52,609 on Friday, up 0.26%, two sessions after printing a record 53,333 and one news cycle into the second official death of the US-Iran ceasefire.

item.title: Crude Oil fades another war spike as the ceasefire dies its daily death
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Crude Oil trades at $70.98 on Friday, down 1%, after a European-morning climb to $72.83 met a wall of New York selling that drove the barrel to a $70.70 session low inside two hours.

item.title: British Pound holds firm as Trump ceasefire shock tests USD
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) holds firm on Friday during the North American session as risk appetite deteriorated after US President Donald Trump posted on social media that the ceasefire with Iran is over, even though negotiations continue.
